original_test_intent: Verify a dedicated Mellanox port accepts the approved IPv6 configuration, completes DAD/neighbor setup, reaches its peer, indicates link physically, loses carrier/reachability and LED when unplugged, then recovers safely.
original_method: Apply reversible IPv6 addressing on an isolated port, validate DAD/routes/neighbors and bounded peer traffic, have an operator remove/reconnect the mapped cable, capture down/recovery state and LED evidence, and restore baseline.
manual_activity: Engineer resolves IPv6 address-disabled semantics and approves plan; operator handles the mapped cable and LED capture; agent performs only approved addressing and bounded protocol checks.
required_inputs: Conflict-free IPv6 address/prefix/zone/route and peer plus DAD/neighbor policy
Definition of address-disabled after carrier loss for global and link-local addresses
Vendor LED on/off legend and qualified operator
Independent OOB/console, restore/recovery and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Validate DAD, neighbor and route impact plus rollback before applying
Use bounded ping6 and stop on duplicate address, neighbor/route conflict, access loss or failed reconnect
Preserve complete logs and operator evidence without clearing
Restore IPv6/routes/neighbors/cable state without auto-reboot or retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect full IPv6/route/neighbor/link baseline and validate approved plan
Apply temporary IPv6 and bounded peer checks on the named interface
Record carrier, DAD/neighbor and reachability across operator disconnect/reconnect and restore baseline
Do not decide ambiguous semantics, handle cables, modify management, retry or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Define assignment versus carrier/neighbor/reachability semantics and LED acceptance
Review complete evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only partially applicable; it omits DAD/neighbor/route acceptance, ping6, physical cable/LED, reconnect and rollback and uses unsafe SSH.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Apply approved temporary IPv6 securely, wait for defined DAD state, preserve addr/route/neigh/link/counters, run bounded ping6 through operator disconnect/reconnect, then restore baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IPv6 setup, correct address, LED-on, ping, cable removal, address/LED-down observation and 10/10 timing fields are preserved pending semantics.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute a reversible IPv6 lifecycle with explicit DAD/neighbor evidence and time-correlated carrier, reachability and LED states.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds protocol-specific conflict checks, reconnect and recovery governance.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: All original checkpoints remain, with ambiguous wording held pending.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: IPv6 link-local/global addresses often remain configured without carrier; neighbor entries and routes may age independently, so disabled needs precise definition.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must define expected behavior separately for global, temporary and link-local addresses and for neighbor/route state.
expected_evidence: Configured DAD-complete address, route, neighbor, bounded ping6 and LED-on evidence
Cable-down carrier, reachability, addr/neighbor behavior and LED-off evidence
Reconnect recovery, complete logs and restored baseline

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The criterion does not define whether IPv6 configuration disappears or only carrier, neighbor and reachability become unavailable after cable removal.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete and the pending semantics do not prevent continuing to later cases.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row67 Wistron-Networking-00050-V003: define whether 'IP addresses should be disable' after cable removal means global/link-local IPv6 assignments disappear, the interface becomes operationally down, neighbors/routes become unusable, or only carrier and peer reachability fail; provide exact NIC/port/netdev, IPv6/prefix/zone/route/peer, DAD and neighbor policy, LED mapping, reconnect recovery, non-management exclusions, OOB/console, rollback and invalid-run rules. Retained IPv6 assignments must not be judged by assumption.

review_improvement: Preserves all IPv6 and physical coverage while separating address, DAD, neighbor, carrier and reachability semantics for engineering judgment.
independent_technical_reasoning: IPv6 configuration, DAD result, neighbor cache, route validity, carrier and reachability are independent states. Cable removal does not necessarily remove global or link-local addresses, so the review must report them separately rather than collapse them into the undefined word disabled.
